Backend has no test framework installed (no pytest in requirements.txt, no tests/ dir). testCommands is intentionally empty.
Frontend has a `verify` script in package.json that runs verify.mjs (ts type-check + TS/Next gate checks). CI verification passes with verdict PASS.
Start command requires Docker daemon running. If Docker is not available in the sandbox, fall back to `npm run build` in frontend and `python -m compileall` in backend as static-only verification.
smokeTarget http://localhost:9090/api/health requires docker compose up -d to have succeeded with a valid .env and a healthy Postgres container.
Worker service (TestZeus Hercules + Playwright Chromium) builds a large Python image and is not needed for basic smoke verification; it is excluded from the minimal start command.
Frontend Dockerfile uses standalone output — the built artifact is a single server.js, not requiring a separate npm start step inside the container.
Node.js 20 (not just >=18) is the correct version — frontend Dockerfile pins node:20-bookworm-slim.
